messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: HIGH — streaming-gateway error spike detected for /v1/stream (5xx/timeouts). Error rate jumped at 10:12 UTC. Auto-escalation to oncall.
oncall-jen: I'm on it. First quick question — is this global or a region? Metrics look noisy across us-east-1 and eu-west-1.
sre-alex: Confirming: elevated 502/504 and a bunch of connection resets. 10:11–10:18 UTC window shows a 18% 5xx rate on streaming route. Non-streaming endpoints stable.
eng-runtime-lee: grabbing streaming-gateway logs now. Running `kubectl logs -l app=stream-gateway -n prod --since=15m` and tailing proxy logs.
eng-runtime-lee: paste: ```
[10:12:05] ERROR stream-gateway: upstream error: Connection reset by peer while proxying chunked body
[10:12:07] WARN  stream-gateway: client canceled stream (client_disconnect)
[10:12:09] ERROR stream-gateway: 502 Bad Gateway from upstream: upstreamWriteTimeout
``` 
infra-sam: Found matching spikes on ALB target health: increased 5xx from gateway nodes of pool `gw-prod-2` at same times. No CPU/mem saturation on pods.
customer-eng-rob: Heads-up — AcmeCorp reported ~30% of sessions failing mid-stream since ~10:12. They flagged this via support ticket #78912. Requesting live mitigation.
product-maya: Impacted customers list? Any telemetry that indicates model-serving backend retries or timeouts?
eng-runtime-lee: Backend model pool logs show longer tail latency for KV cache reads around same window, but backend didn't return 5xx — gateway returns 502 when upstream close happens during chunked response. I suspect an upstream proxy reading behavior (nginx/ingress) hitting read timeout.
sre-alex: Can we confirm proxy_read_timeout / keepalive settings? Also check `proxy_buffering` — short buffers + chunked streams can cause resets under burst.
oncall-jen: Quick mitigation proposals — 1) enable streaming->paged fallback for customers with retries/known clients, 2) increase gateway replicas behind ALB, 3) bump proxy_read_timeout on Nginx ingress to 120s, 4) temporarily mark `gw-prod-2` as draining and shift traffic.
eng-runtime-lee: I can flip the feature-flag to force fallback for AcmeCorp only via our routing policy: `route.override(acme, fallback=paged)` — will do if we need immediate relief.
infra-sam: Starting a rolling restart of gw-prod-2 nodes and increasing desired count from 6 -> 9 to absorb burst. Doing in small batches.
oncall-jen: Alex — can you create a realtime dashboard and add a short-lived trace span for a failing request so we can see exact handshake errors between gateway and model-proxy?
sre-alex: Added dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/streaming/stream-gateway-live — added spans for proxy.write errors, client_cancel, and upstream_timeouts. Also enabled debug logging on two pods (gw-2a, gw-2b).
eng-runtime-lee: Debug logs show upstream idle for 45s then upstream responded but gateway connection already closed. Looks like upstream delayed chunk, proxy timed out on our side while waiting to send chunk to client (client might have kept connection open but NGinx closed due to buffer pressure).
customer-eng-rob: AcmeCorp confirms they see repeated truncated responses and reconnect loops. They're okay with paged fallback as a stopgap.
oncall-jen: Okay, immediate plan: (A) route AcmeCorp -> paged fallback (Lee), (B) increase gw replicas + restart (Sam), (C) bump proxy_read_timeout to 120s for streaming ingress (Ops, change controlled config), (D) keep debug logs for 1 hour, (E) oncall will monitor and decide on rollback. Execute and report when done.
eng-runtime-lee: Pushed route override for AcmeCorp at 10:24 UTC — confirmed via logs: `route: acme -> fallback=paged`. They're seeing a >90% success rate now.
infra-sam: Replica scale triggered at 10:25, rolling restart started 10:26. ALB draining for gw-prod-2 node set. Proxy config change planned in 5m (need approvals via infra-change channel).
sre-alex: Saw immediate drop in 5xx for routed/fallback traffic. Global 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 7% by 10:33 as traffic rebalanced.
product-maya: Documenting customer impact, ETA for next update? Also need a post-incident note to include config delta and rollback plan.
oncall-jen: We still see some client_cancel signals — likely long-polling clients that give up. For mitigation, consider adding client retry guidance and server side heartbeat to keep connections alive longer.
eng-runtime-lee: Suspect root cause: inter-op between ingress proxy buffering and our streaming chunking under high concurrency leading to upstream write timeouts. Next steps: reproduce load in staging with chunk sizes and Nginx buffer configs, add defensive backpressure in gateway, and add metrics for chunked-frame drops.
customer-eng-rob: AcmeCorp CS confirms they are back to normal on paged fallback. They'll accept a full incident report and timeline.
oncall-jen: Handing off to infra-sam for config rollback/cleanup and eng-runtime-lee for root cause and follow-up. Oncall shift next is @sre-alex in 2 hours.
infra-sam: I'll keep the scaled replicas for 30m then revert to normal. Will also apply proxy_read_timeout patch and monitor.
eng-runtime-lee: I'll open PR with tests that simulate slow upstream chunking and add circuit for client cancel detection. Linking issue: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/5123
oncall-jen: Thanks team. Summary for export: elevated 5xx/timeouts on streaming route due to gateway+ingress chunked interplay; mitigated by per-customer paged fallback, scaling, and ingress timeout bump. Handoff — monitoring for 2h, action items assigned.
incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated -> MONITORING. Pager cleared at 10:42 UTC. :white_check_mark:
